title: Venus retrograde in Scorpio: everyone's ex moved back
caption: venus turned back in scorpio on oct 3. who came back for you?

beats.text: everyone's ex moved back to town
venus turned back in scorpio on the 3rd
the cafe is making their old order again
so the old names get louder at night
begun in scorpio, nothing comes back casually
ask why they left before why they're back
some just want to see if you'll answer
a second look is not a second chance
who came back for you this october?
